title: The imp module was removed in Python 3.12
summary: Python 3.12 removed the imp module, so importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError; use importlib.

sources.title: Python 3.11 documentation: imp — Access the import internals

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the imp import
steps.instructions: Replace each reported import of imp with importlib.
